tier: T0 observations and T2 deterministic transforms; nothing here is a model, a price, a projection or a grade

lines.basis: nflverse/nfldata games.csv; the spread, total and moneyline columns are the consensus close as nflverse carries them, no book, no capture time

margin_frequency.sign_convention: abs: |home − away|. fav_signed: the closing favourite's score minus the underdog's (negative = the favourite lost); pick'em closes are excluded and counted.
margin_frequency.includes: regular season and postseason, overtime included

windows.note: every settled game in the archive

two_point.definition: two-point tries ÷ (extra-point tries + two-point tries), nflverse play-by-play; no_play rows (penalties) excluded
two_point.scope: regular season (the drift line); postseason weeks are kept in weeks[] and excluded from the share

drift.rule: share of tries that went for two, season to date vs the pooled prior three seasons; |z| ≥ 2 is reported as a move. Descriptive: it feeds nothing.

ats.basis: closing consensus line (nflverse games.csv), pushes shown and excluded from the rate

note: Descriptive. The Market Structure section shows it; the registered EXPERIMENTAL studies read it; no projection, spread, probability, EV, ranking or grade does.
